Every lane's private dockerd starts empty and pulls each pinned image from its registry: a four-lane campaign costs about four times the Docker Hub pulls of a serial one, and the unauthenticated limit of this host's address is 100 pulls per hour; a four-lane run right after another pulling run can fail at setup with 429 (the diagnostic attempt of this unit).
